heading: Hinges tucked into the frame.
final_view: Selected Chrome tab, fully unfolded in Orbit view with all three board envelopes shown.
assembled_view: Four integral bearing crowns are visible along the two seams. The long end extensions are gone. The hinge section shows a foot integrated into the chassis base.
board_inspection: At 100%, only the three board envelopes lift. The three joined trays and all lifted boards remain in frame.
rear_access: Rear preset exposes access openings through the ribs and the illustrative board envelopes.
section_closeup: Cut plane and bright solid cross-section render for the seam bearing.
flat_plate: One assembled chassis lies flat on the white square plate, without loose frames or hinge cartridges.
ui_observations: The rear preset remains dim, which makes connector detail difficult to identify.
Hinge close-up retains the general unfolded caption.
scope: Browser and embedded 3MF geometry verification. Mechanical fit and print behavior were not tested.
